bio.text: Dolly Henley represents District 88 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes Hempstead County and parts of Miller and Howard counties, and is serving her first term.

Before the legislature, Henley was recreation director for the City of Hope and director of parks and recreation for the City of Nashville, Arkansas. While executive director of Hempstead Hall at the University of Arkansas Hope-Texarkana, she earned an Associate of Arts degree.
She lives in Washington, Arkansas, with her husband.
